_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Manmatha Nath Dutt (1855-1912): the prose Rāmāyana (Calcutta, 1891-94, 4 vols), the Harivamsha (1897) and the Vishnupuranam (1896, based on H. H. Wilson's translation). Not R. C. Dutt, whose verse epics are on Lane D's dutt shelf. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 34); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
